newsitem.title: UK: Littlewoods to sell Russian, Indian stores.
newsitem.headline: Littlewoods to sell Russian, Indian stores.

text.p: British retail group Littlewoods said on Thursday it planned to sell its retailing operations in Russia and India in a move to focus on its core home shopping and leisure businesses.

"Despite difficult trading conditions, the stores in Russia and India have produced encouraging sales. However, the businesses have reached a stage where further substantial investment was required to take the business forward...it is no longer appropriate to continue international operations and we are seeking buyers," the company said in a statement.

Littlewoods had four stores in St. Petersburg in Russia and franchise operations in several other Russian cities. Littlewoods International retail operations employs 320 people in Russia and 15 in Britain, the company said.
Littlewoods said its Bangalore store in India employs 120 people.
